domain: 53121 original legal PVR empty MOBILE opportunities; original-account conditional domain, not new policy
features: within day and sector original_PVR ascending average percentile
log(native signal close / original candidate floor) / pre-existing PVR scale
train: signal t >= cutoff-504 and t+60 < cutoff, all three states and all payoff distributions use same 60-mature feature-complete source-continuous rows
targets: C=first close >=2*next_open-floor within20 before close<=floor; F=first close<=floor, INCLUDING next_open<=floor as F0 at time0; U=neither. No trade exit. Finite positive immediate next open required for label only, never used in test features or rank eligibility.
payoff: existing adjusted C[t+60]/O[t+1]-1 minus fixed40bp proxy; no actual commissions, taxes, liquidity, dividends double count or trading claim
labels: state mature20, payoff/ES mature60. Main training deliberately waits60 for all. Missing path or source segment break unknown, not loss; unfilled treated identically to filled.
feature_scaling: Risk feature only: weighted empirical1%99% bounds using training rows only, winsorize first, then weighted mean/std, final z clip+/-5. Other features unchanged. floor-scale UNKNOWN has fixed original rank slots.
weights: equal signal date, equal sector within date, equal event within sector-date; normalize sum to row count
probability_model: Exact same convex likelihood and ridge2 as v1, NumPy damped Newton already audited. Max200, gradient max<1e-4 required; no new tuning.
conditional_distribution: for each C/F/U, date/sector-balanced empirical payoff distribution in current market regime; fallback to all regimes if none. Sector empirical date-balanced distribution shrunk toward pool by lambda=distinct sector-state dates/(n+20). Full returns preserved.
score: mixture expected payoff / exact fractional worst10% loss of mixture. If ES<=0/nonfinite UNKNOWN original slot. pC is second ranking.
direct_mean: same 3 features, same training/weights/standardization, squared-error objective sum w residual^2 +4 sum(beta^2), no intercept penalty
history_mean: sector/current-market date-balanced mean shrunk to market mean by dates/(dates+20); constant within day-sector, PVR tiebreak
ranking: original global topK=min(20,N) determines per-sector K; replace known slots only within each sector; all methods same sector counts, same totalK. UNKNOWN positions fixed. No score>0 or probability gate.
evaluation: year/924/2026Q1; 5/20/60 price paths, 40bp and100bp cost proxies; paired all-method complete dates; 60-session block clustered uncertainty; primary price60; original root early big coverage and source-account closed-round association only
stability: monthly parameters/support, per-year known fraction, same-date-sector score rank correlations and changes, probability Brier vs same-train historical state proportions
known_limitations: Consumed history, future-selected universe/industry and adjustments not PIT; price proxy only, not executable net0-to0 win rate
reason_not_old_CE: Old joint CE predicted actual-filled final net win with 120-session W/L/U and 1814 selected fills. This predicts price path C/F/U and 60-day distributions on all53121 original legal opportunities, keeps same-sector K and observes candidate counterfactual prices, not synthetic actual PnL.
numerical_fix: Original PVR scale <=1e-8 numerical floor means UNKNOWN at signal time. For risk-distance feature only, compute training date/sector-weighted empirical inverse-CDF quantiles1%/99%, clip TRAIN and TEST to these frozen training bounds BEFORE weighted mean/std; retain original final +/-5. Other two features unchanged.
